name: [UPD] +1 Drain Water Per Click
desc:
💧 Welcome to **+1 Drain Water Per Click!**

🚰 Every click gives you +1 WATER!
🌊 Drain the Pool and collect all the Water!
🐟 Empty the Pool to discover rare and legendary Fish!
🏊 Drain bigger Pools and unlock new Areas!
🗺️ Explore new Lakes with amazing surprises!
⚡ Unlock powerful upgrades and drain faster!
👑 Collect Wins and become the ULTIMATE Water Master!

🐾 Collect Pets for huge Water boosts!
🐠 Find legendary Fish and build your collection!
🚀 Unlock OP upgrades and dominate the Lakes!
📱 Supports ALL Devices!

👍 Like & Favorite if you enjoy the game!
